description: This file contains pytest test cases for testing a FastAPI application's form submission endpoints. It dynamically imports app modules for different configurations and tests various request scenarios including success, validation errors, and OpenAPI schema correctness.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that dynamically imports a module based on request parameters and returns a TestClient for the app within that module.

methods.name: test_post_body_form(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests a successful POST request with form data containing username and password.

methods.name: test_post_body_extra_form(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests POST request with extra form data, expecting a validation error.

methods.name: test_post_body_form_no_password(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests POST request missing the password field, expecting a validation error.

methods.name: test_post_body_form_no_username(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests POST request missing the username field, expecting a validation error.

methods.name: test_post_body_form_no_data(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests POST request with no form data, expecting multiple validation errors.

methods.name: test_post_body_json(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests POST request with JSON data instead of form data, expecting validation error.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Fetches the OpenAPI JSON schema from the FastAPI app and verifies it matches expected structure.
